q: Does ferro-silicon from Bhutan face EU CBAM?
title: Bhutanese ferro-silicon: CBAM check
short: No, not under the current goods list. Among ferroalloys, CBAM covers ferro-manganese, ferro-chromium and ferro-nickel only, so ferro-silicon is outside it. Bhutan is not one of the exempt countries, so any covered goods it ships would still need figures.
audience: Ferroalloy producers in Bhutan and EU steel buyers

p: EU steel mills ask for alloy footprints for their own reporting. Electricity, reductant and electrode records serve both.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, power and production records into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions your EU importer asks for.

sources.label: European Commission, CBAM legislation and guidance
